job_email_checks_lengths.name: job_email_checks_lengths

org_invites_shape.name: org_invites_shape
org_invites_shape.value: ("org_invites"."kind" = 'invite') = ("org_invites"."email_hash" is not null) and ("org_invites"."kind" = 'request') = ("org_invites"."user_id" is not null)

user_settings_resigned_needs_days.name: user_settings_resigned_needs_days

job_saves_not_empty.name: job_saves_not_empty
job_saves_not_empty.value: "job_saves"."saved_at" is not null or "job_saves"."stage" is not null

user_resources_not_empty.name: user_resources_not_empty
user_resources_not_empty.value: "user_resources"."saved_at" is not null or "user_resources"."finished_at" is not null or "user_resources"."on_ride_at" is not null

resource_suggestions_decline_reason.name: resource_suggestions_decline_reason
